identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a top 1% automotive marketplace that feels industrial, precise, and trustworthy, avoiding generic SaaS aesthetics.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Industrial Precision with Consumer Simplicity.
Emotion First: Trust and Clarity are the core emotions.
Content is King: Data (Part Numbers, Specs) must be legible and beautiful.
Zoom In: Use macro photography of glass/parts to create texture.
Negative Space: Use whitespace to separate dense data tables.

heading.usage: All Headings (H1-H6), Price Tags, Part Numbers

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI Labels, Inputs, Table Data

rules: Part Numbers must be 'font-mono' or 'Barlow Condensed' for readability.

buttons.style: Sharp edges or very slight rounding (rounded-sm). High contrast.
buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all

cards.style: Flat, 1px border (border-slate-200), no shadow by default. Shadow-lg on hover.
cards.listing_card: flex flex-row items-center justify-between p-6 border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors

inputs.style: h-12 bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-transparent rounded-sm

navigation.style: Sticky, Glassmorphism effect (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md). Border-b border-slate-200.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for search overlays and sticky headers to mimic 'Auto Glass'.
visual_enhancers.technical_borders: Use 'border-r border-slate-200' on grid items to create a technical spec sheet look.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Buttons should have a slight 'scale-95' on click. Links should have a growing underline on hover.

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons. Use 'Wrench', 'Car', 'Search', 'MapPin', 'Phone', 'User' icons.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use generic 'SaaS Blue' gradients. Use solid, deep colors.
DO NOT center text in the hero unless it is a massive headline.
DO NOT use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Keep it sharp (rounded-sm) for an industrial feel.
ALWAYS use 'Manrope' for body text and 'Barlow Condensed' for headings.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (APCA/WCAG AA).
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building the frontend for Auto Glass Hub. Follow these guidelines strictly. Use the provided image URLs for the respective sections. Implement the 'Barlow Condensed' and 'Manrope' fonts immediately in the index.css or index.html. Use the defined color palette in tailwind.config.js.
